name: my-shopify-barebone-app
description: @shopify/cli must be installed by `npm install -g @shopify/cli`, and @shopify/app is used by `@shopify/ui-extensions-react` only.

scripts.build: cd frontend && pnpm run build && rm -rf ../public/assets && mkdir -p ../public && mv dist/assets ../public/assets && mkdir -p ../views && mv dist/index.html ../views/index.html && cd .. && react-router build
